subject.title: [Bug]:  [Windows] exec spawn: all commands hang with no output (stdio pipe deadlock)

question: Should maintainers run native Windows 11 and Node 24 exec proof for this PowerShell-started gateway hang before keeping, fixing, or closing the issue?
rationale: Source inspection shows relevant hardening but not a current native proof path, and the older closed Windows empty-output reports do not cover the timeout-hang symptom.

options.title: Run native Windows proof
options.body: Use a native Windows gateway run to capture stdout, stderr, PID, exit status, timeout behavior, and process tree for `echo hello` and `node -v`, then decide the fix path from that trace.

options.title: Wait for reporter evidence
options.body: Keep the issue open but request a current version, logs, and a short recording or transcript before spending maintainer validation time.

options.title: Close after stale threshold
options.body: If no new evidence arrives after the stale policy threshold, close as insufficiently reproducible with a request for a fresh report containing native Windows proof.

recommendation.title: Run native Windows proof
recommendation.body: Use a native Windows gateway run to capture stdout, stderr, PID, exit status, timeout behavior, and process tree for `echo hello` and `node -v`, then decide the fix path from that trace.
